Manage internal and built-in objects with privileged access.

This command provides admin-only access to:
  - Built-in objects (e.g., COMP-TYPE-* component types) - normally immutable
  - Internal objects (objects with visibility: internal)
  - System objects in _internal directories

Built-in objects are shareable/reusable but immutable unless accessed through
this command with admin privileges.

Command organization:
  Common operations: list, get, create, update, delete, bulk (work for all internal object kinds)
  Kind-based operations: <kind> fields (explore fields for a specific internal kind)
  Specialized operations: (future: lifecycle management, spec management, etc.)

Examples:
  # Common operations
  zqk internal list component --built-in
  zqk internal get COMP-TYPE-001
  zqk internal create object_spec --file spec.yaml
  zqk internal update COMP-TYPE-001 --field title="Updated Title"
  zqk internal delete COMP-TYPE-001
  zqk internal object_spec fields
  zqk internal bulk create kind_synonym --file synonyms.yaml

Usage:
  zqk internal [command]

Available Commands:
  <kind>      Operations for a specific internal object kind
  bulk        Bulk operations for multiple internal objects (admin only)
  count       Count internal or built-in objects by kind
  create      Create an internal object (admin only)
  delete      Delete an internal or built-in object (admin only)
  fields      List internal object kinds or explore fields (use internal <kind> fields for a specific kind)
  get         Get an internal or built-in object by ID
  lifecycle   Operations for a specific internal object kind
  list        List internal or built-in objects
  object_spec Operations for a specific internal object kind
  process     Process a reference file with operations or data (admin only)
  update      Update an internal or built-in object (admin only)

Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running

Use "zqk internal [command] --help" for more information about a command.
